name: Month Calendar
tip: Select the month name above the calendar to open or create the monthly note. Select a week number to open the weekly note.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Month Calendar is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trusting it with your notes.
